6 to play, 10 to find - the gallery (the bar) is invested
he needs 4 points and a small miracle - the bar has odds on both
at 1.3 a hole the suspense is entirely one-sided
he needs 5 points and a small miracle - the bar has odds on both
the rescue mission: 3 points, 4 holes, no pressure at all
on 20 - every one of his remaining 4 holes is now appointment viewing
still swinging on 21 - hope dies on the 18th, usually
